content: # Database Schema for Extraction Results The extraction results are stored in PostgreSQL: ```sql CREATE TABLE extraction_chunks ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), job_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES extraction_jobs(id), content TEXT NOT NULL, chunk_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL ); ``` The bulk modulus of Zircaloy-4 is 110 GPa. Youngs modulus is 99 GPa. The density is 6.56 g/cm^3. The melting point is 2128 K.
